description: Added support for WebP and AVIF image formats in addition to JPEG, PNG, and GIF.
Added new status value 'reserved' to the status enum for pets that are on hold.
Endpoint officially deprecated. Will be removed in v4.0. Use GET /pet/findByStatus or GET /pet/{petId} instead.
Changed from OAuth2 implicit flow to authorization code flow. Updated authorization URL to /api/oauth/authorize.
Fixed orderId parameter type from string to integer (int64) to match other order endpoints.
Added 'reserved' status to inventory response map. Response now includes four status categories.
Added X-Token-Type response header indicating the authentication token format (Bearer or API-Key).
Added server-side validation for quantity field. Must be between 1 and 100. Returns 400 for invalid values.
Implemented global rate limiting: 1000 requests/hour for authenticated users, 100 requests/hour for anonymous.
Added 'lastLoginDate' field (ISO 8601 format) to the User response schema.
Fixed incorrect 405 response code. Now returns 422 (Unprocessable Entity) when validation fails.
Updated base server URL from http://petstore.swagger.io/v2 to https://api.petstore.io/v3.
Added standard pagination support via 'page' and 'per_page' query parameters on all list endpoints.
Enforced HTTPS for all API endpoints. HTTP requests now return 301 redirect.
